Definition: a primary particle; properly, at the "same" time, but freely used as a preposition or adverb denoting close association:--also, and, together, with(-al).
BiblicalUsage: Hama means together, at the same time, and it quietly shapes the verses it stands in. In Matthew 13:29 the wheat and the tares grow together until the harvest, in Romans 3:12 the whole world has gone together out of the way, and in 1 Thessalonians 4:17 the living are caught up together with the risen dead to meet the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe together is the word that holds the church fast: we grow together, we fall together, and one day we rise together.
